descriptors.concept_name: Discontinuing The Use Of The Equity Method
descriptors.definition: An entity must stop applying the equity method when its investment ceases to qualify as an associate or a joint venture. Any retained interest is then accounted for as a financial asset measured at fair value, with differences recognized in profit or loss.
inclusion: measurement of retained interest at fair value
recognition of gain or loss on partial disposal and discontinuation in profit or loss
exclusion: continued application of the equity method when joint control or significant influence persists
retaining historical carrying amounts without fair value adjustment for retained financial assets
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from business combinations where previously held interests are revalued upon gaining control versus discontinuation resulting in financial asset classification.

descriptors.concept_name: Classification Of Investment In Associate Or Joint Venture As Held For Sale
descriptors.definition: Portions of an investment in an associate or joint venture meeting specified criteria must follow the standard for non-current assets held for sale. Any unsold retained portions continue under the equity method until disposal, after which accounting depends on the retention of joint control.
inclusion: applying held-for-sale criteria to portions of investments
retrospective application of the equity method if classification as held for sale ceases
exclusion: immediate derecognition of retained portions before disposal
applying held-for-sale standards to portions lacking disposal plans
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from permanent discontinuation of the equity method by applying temporary held-for-sale rules and potential retrospective reinstatement.

descriptors.concept_name: Significant Changes In Ind As 28 From Ias 28 Resulting Into Carve Out
descriptors.definition: Ind AS 28 includes an impracticability carve-out from the requirement to use uniform accounting policies between an investor and its associates. This exemption accommodates entities like regional rural banks that cannot feasibly implement advanced accounting standards.
inclusion: exempting specific associates from uniform policy adjustments due to practical limitations
exclusion: mandatory uniform policy alignment when it is practicable to do so
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from strict IFRS requirements by introducing a localized impracticability exemption for specific categories of associates.

descriptors.concept_name: Significant Differences Between Ind As 28 And AS 23
descriptors.definition: Ind AS 28 differs from AS 23 regarding the definition and assessment of significant influence, the treatment of potential voting rights, and exemptions for applying the equity method. It also includes specific provisions for fair value measurement through profit or loss and held-for-sale classifications.
terminology: fair value through profit or loss
inclusion: comparison of criteria for significant influence and potential voting rights
differences in equity method application exemptions and held-for-sale treatment
exclusion: treating old GAAP standards as identical to current Ind AS frameworks
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished by contrasting modern Ind AS rules with legacy AS 23 provisions concerning investment definitions and restrictions.
